profile_text.body:
Atlassian is a publicly traded Australian software company, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sydney, that makes collaboration and project management tools aimed at software, IT, and business teams. Its core products include Jira, Confluence, Trello, and Loom, which the company describes as forming one connected platform for planning, tracking, and delivering work. Atlassian trades on the Nasdaq under the ticker TEAM and reported revenue of approximately $5.215 billion for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, according to its most recent 10-K filing.

On the AI side, Atlassian has introduced AI capabilities across its product suite. Confluence AI adds smart links, automation, and knowledge management features to its team wiki tool, while Trello AI brings workflow automation to its project management offering. The company also references Rovo AI agents as part of its broader platform, with governance handled through Atlassian Cloud. The site describes the platform as designed to support evolving standards and regulatory requirements.

Atlassian's SEC filings are made under CIK 0001650372. No litigation or MCP server registrations appear in the held facts for this company.
